title: A Benchmark for Zero-Shot Belief Inference in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating belief prediction accuracy by providing LLMs with user demographic attributes (age, gender, ethnicity, income, relationship status) in an informational ablation framework to measure the models' reliance on population-level statistical priors and demographic stereotypes.

Providing users' political and religious ideologies as background context to test how well models infer individual stances on varied debate propositions based on ideological associations and sociopolitical framing.
